item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We refuse to trade our collective agency for a race to build machines more powerful than us.

2. We cannot call it progress if humanity loses the power to choose what comes next. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, that loss of control will be permanent. We must stop this race before it decides our future for us.

3. We want a future humanity can shape—not one we surrender to superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, we will permanently lose control. We demand that preserving human agency come before speed, profit and technological prestige.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe humanity’s future must remain ours to shape. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We reject the idea that this is a price worth paying for technological progress. Our freedom to decide how we live, what we value and what we pass on to future generations is not expendable. We must stop the race toward superintelligence and demand that human control take priority over corporate competition. We are organising around a clear commitment: we will not surrender humanity’s future to systems more powerful than us. The decisions we make now must protect our ability to decide tomorrow.
